description: This Java class 'DefaultSseConfig' provides a default implementation for the SSE (Server-Sent Events) configuration, primarily managing throttling settings. It includes methods to instantiate the configuration from a Typesafe Config object, along with standard object methods (equals, hashCode, toString).

classes.name: DefaultSseConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing the SseConfig interface, managing throttling configuration for SSE.

methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultSseConfig from a Typesafe Config object.
